dependencies.reason: Wave 2 validation must be APPROVED before Wave 3 begins.

critical_notes: HARDEST session. IR-02 is the most complex fix in the plan.
If estimated context exceeds 60K tokens mid-session → split into sub-sessions 12a and 12b.
Implement resolveCallChain() in IRBuilder.php: depth limit=2, cycle detection via visited[], SymbolTable::findMethod() for resolution.
Run SourceSinkVisitor on resolved method bodies — inherit entry_point_id from parent callback.
Test pattern: callback → $this->helper() → $wpdb->query($input). BEFORE fix: no SQL sink. AFTER fix: SQL sink with correct entry_point_id.
IR-10 trait resolution (Session 8) is a hard prerequisite — resolveCallChain relies on findMethod() working for trait-defined methods.
No benchmark test plugin currently covers this pattern — may need to create a minimal test fixture.

files_to_read.reason: Primary change target — implement resolveCallChain() and integrate into Phase 3 callback body loop

IR-02.change: Implement resolveCallChain(array $callExprNodes, SymbolTable $symbols, string $currentClass, string $entryPointId, int $depth=0, int $maxDepth=2, array &$visited=[]): array. For each MethodCall node in callback body: lookup via findMethod(), extract body, run SourceSinkVisitor with inherited entry_point_id, recurse up to depth=2. Integrate into Phase 3 loop after SourceSinkVisitor traversal of callback body.
